comment: Reviewed sweep findings deliberately not mirrored into the MCPA database. ids: individual GHSA/CVE/OSV ids; packages: ecosystem:name channels whose non-MCP app-level advisories are delegated to general scanners (osv-scanner et al). Rationale is recorded in the GAP report named next to each group.

rationale.GHSA-q94p-g4rh-r9rf: NanoClaw is not a registry package the package-runner matcher can see (GAP-ROUND-27)
rationale.GHSA-fjwc-rc47-268g: Kirachon context-engine (context-engine-mcp-server) is not published to any registry; the npm/PyPI packages named context-engine are unrelated projects (GAP-ROUND-267)
rationale.GHSA-c8c4-xf97-vvc8: INQUIRELAB mcp-bridge-api is rolling-release, not in npm/PyPI — same mapping bar as round 261 (GAP-ROUND-267)
rationale.GHSA-8cv7-xjpc-f5hw: abdullah1854 MCPGateway is a commit-ranged GitHub-only project, not in any registry (GAP-ROUND-267)
rationale.GHSA-wgq9-x672-9734: adolfosalasgomez3011 slidev-builder-mcp is GitHub-only, not published to npm or PyPI — same mapping bar as rounds 261/267 (GAP-ROUND-281)
rationale.npm:flowise: platform-level CVEs delegated to osv-scanner; MCP-specific flowise advisories are still ingested (GAP-ROUND-22, MCPA-2026-0006); the GHSA keyword sweep still surfaces new MCP-related flowise advisories
rationale.MAL-2026-13259: chatcc-agent is a commercial Claude Code<->IM bridge (CCLink) whose remote terminal/PTY channel is JWT- plus paired-client-authenticated and is the product's advertised purpose; the OSV entry documents the remote-shell design, not a concealed payload or exfiltration channel. Rationale: GAP-ROUND-291.
rationale.MAL-2026-13210: @ohos-ports/codex is a third-party HarmonyOS port that resolves @openai/codex from a mutable gitcode.com branch tarball; real supply-chain risk but no payload observed and no impersonation of the @openai publisher's own package name. Rationale: GAP-ROUND-291.
rationale.MAL-2026-10892: claude-code-timer: the OSV entry itself records 'scanned with no findings of concern' (no lifecycle scripts, no attacker-controlled network calls). Rationale: GAP-ROUND-291.
rationale.MAL-2026-12401: mcp-audit-sync-internal@99.9.9 is a dependency-confusion placeholder for an internal name, not a package agent users install; delegated to general scanners. Rationale: GAP-ROUND-291.
rationale.GHSA-6cmv-x2ph-3gc2: abrinsmead mindpilot-mcp is GitHub-only, not published to npm or PyPI (rechecked: both 404) — same mapping bar as rounds 261/267/281 (GAP-ROUND-295)
rationale.GHSA-4p6x-rj5h-hg93: astralisone rive-mcp-server-core is GitHub-only, not published to npm or PyPI (rechecked: both 404) (GAP-ROUND-295)
rationale.GHSA-rrf2-j3h9-99wg: andreahaku llm_memory_mcp is GitHub-only, not published to npm or PyPI (rechecked: llm_memory_mcp and llm-memory-mcp both 404) (GAP-ROUND-295)
rationale.GHSA-rhx7-52rr-88vg: zyr-agent's hardcoded free-tier provider endpoint is the product's advertised behavior; no hidden payload found in the unpacked tarball (GAP-ROUND-306)
rationale.GHSA-xqpm-2h7j-xm8c: chatcc-agent re-listed under a new GHSA id; same commercial IM-bridge rationale as MAL-2026-13259 (GAP-ROUND-291)
rationale.GHSA-jhgm-wgrp-wf2h: @ohos-ports/codex re-listed under a new GHSA id; same mutable-tarball-without-payload rationale as MAL-2026-13210 (GAP-ROUND-291)
rationale.GHSA-748q-7cjg-cvvx: @vanexalabs-ai/vanexa-agent: relay pairing is the advertised product behavior; no hidden payload found (GAP-ROUND-306)
rationale.GHSA-p2hv-cfx8-pv93: @agenthub-ai/agent is a security-holder placeholder; the active malicious surface is the unscoped agenthub-ai, covered as MCPA-2026-0080 (GAP-ROUND-306)
rationale.GHSA-q7rv-gfpp-m23j: @zzzcrypto/solana-spl-token is a crypto-library typosquat outside the agent/MCP ecosystem; delegated to the OSV live check (GAP-ROUND-307)
rationale.GHSA-xp7w-qh77-w69x: twork-data-services-sme-agent-company-relation is a dependency-confusion placeholder for an internal name (GAP-ROUND-307)
rationale.GHSA-936x-86fr-fp2f: @servicetitan/anvil2-mcp compromised versions were removed from npm and no public payload analysis exists to verify; lockfile matches are covered by the OSV live check (GAP-ROUND-307)
rationale.GHSA-5xcj-w4qg-g78g: refbase-mcp and the following mcp-named entries are npm security-holder placeholders (0.0.1-security), nothing installable to analyze; delegated to the OSV live check (GAP-ROUND-307)
